question: Who among the following was elected as the President of the All India Chess Federation in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjay Kapoor**__.

__
 
• **Sanjay Kapoor was elected President of the All India Chess Federation (AICF) while Bharat Singh Chauhan retained the Secretary’s post in the polls held online on 4 January 2021**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **The All India Chess Federation (AICF) **is the central administrative body for the game of chess in India. 

 
 
• Established in 1951.
 
• The organization is also in charge of managing women's chess in India.
 
• It's present headquarter is in New Delhi.
